asked.item: cleanTranscript=true still returns timestamps on GET
is the param named differently in REST

verdict.reason: The pages say cleanTranscript is not a REST parameter and that cleaning is a client-side step, which covers all three items.

steps.text: cleanTranscript is not a REST query parameter, so sending it to this endpoint won't change the response.
The n8n Blotato node's Source > Get operation has a local Clean Transcript option, enabled by default, that processes the returned content after the API request.
The page doesn't list a REST parameter under another name. It calls cleaning a client-side transformation, not an API query option.
For REST, retrieve the completed content first, then remove the transcript timestamps in your agent or workflow.
